For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Praveen Kumar
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.A.G
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Sunil Kumar Panwar
 Oral Order
4 23-03-2023
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

The petitioner has filed the instant application for grant of regular bail in connection with Bhagwanganj P.S. Case No. 53 of 2022 registered under sections 376 and 511 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 4 and 8 of the POCSO Act.
Prosecution case relates to attempt of rape upon the grand daughter of the informant by the petitioner.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence.
He has falsely been implicated in this case with false and concocted allegations.
He is an old man aged about 65 years.

The victim has not stated anything in her statement recorded under Section Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.64202 of 2022(4) dt.23-03-2023 164 of the Cr.P.C. rather on behalf of the victim, her grand mother explained about the prosecution case.
It is further submitted that the informant is not the eye-witness of the alleged occurrence.
It is also submitted that there is difference in the statement of 161 and 164 of the Cr.P.C.
A statement has been made in para-3 of this petition that the petitioner has got no criminal antecedent.

He is languishing in Surendra Yadav @ Surendra Prasad Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88765298/
1 judicial custody since 27.05.2022.

entities.text: Surendra Yadav @ Surendra Prasad Singh vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The application for bail is vehemently opposed by learned APP for the State.

Having heard learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of the case as well as the custody of the petitioner, the Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

The above named petitioner is directed to be enlarged on bail in connection with Bhagwanganj P.S. Case No. 53 of 2022 on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Sessions Judge-VII cum Exclusive Special Court (POCSO Act), Patna.
